difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-shriek, the lemma asserts that the constructions of Lemmas labelled lemma-shriek-well-defined and lemma-upper-shriek-composition define a pseudo functor from FTS_S into the two category of categories, in the sense of Categories, Definition labelled categories-definition-functor-into-2-category (statement lines 4369-4376). The proof must show that for composable f, g, h the square relating (h o g o f)^!, f^! o (h o g)^!, (g o f)^! o h^! and f^! o g^! o h^! commutes (proof lines 4378-4384). It chooses compactifications of Z over T, then of Y over the compactification of Z, then of X over the compactification of Y, using More on Flatness, Theorem labelled flat-theorem-nagata and Lemma labelled flat-lemma-compactifyable, and lets W be the inverse image of Z in the compactification of Y and U contained in V the inverse images of Y and of W in the compactification of X (proof lines 4386-4398). This produces the four by four diagram whose squares are labelled A, B and C, and, arguing exactly as in Lemma labelled lemma-upper-shriek-composition, the maps in the first square use the maps of equation labelled equation-sheafy for the rectangles A + B, B + C and for the squares A and C (proof lines 4400-4416). Lemmas labelled lemma-compose-base-change-maps and lemma-compose-base-change-maps-horizontal give gamma_{A+B} = gamma_A o gamma_B and gamma_{B+C} = gamma_C o gamma_B, so the desired equality holds once gamma_A o gamma_C = gamma_C o gamma_A, which holds because the squares A and C meet in one point, as in the last argument of Remark labelled remark-going-around (proof lines 4418-4424). Combining the vertical and horizontal composition rules and isolating the commuting pair of distant squares is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2.
